mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with ropinirole (dopamine agonist) increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonergic syndrome through inhibition of monoamine oxidase and enhanced dopaminergic/noradrenergic activity.
action: Avoid concomitant use; if necessary, use with extreme caution under close blood pressure monitoring and consider alternative antidepressants with lower MAOI potency or non-MAOI agents.
